title: Jamaican Spiced Yam Skewers
description: A Caribbean-inspired dish featuring smoky yam skewers infused with the warmth of Jamaican spices.
instructions: Cut yam into 1-inch cubes, leaving a small amount of space between each piece.
Thread yam cubes onto skewers, leaving a small amount of space between each piece.
In a small bowl, mix together velvety and jamaican spices.
Brush the yam skewers with the spice mixture, making sure to coat evenly.
Grill the skewers for 12-15 minutes, turning occasionally, until yam is tender and slightly charred.
Serve hot, garnished with a sprinkle of additional jamaican spice if desired.
